references.text: This is one of the Ten Commandments, which says 'Honor your father and your mother', forming the basis for Jesus' words in Matthew 19:19.
This verse also contains the command to love your neighbor as yourself, which Jesus refers to.
Jesus repeats the command to love your neighbor as yourself, showing the importance of this commandment in his teaching.
This is a parallel to Jesus' words in Matthew, where he says that loving your neighbor as yourself is the second most important commandment.
Although this verse does not directly mention loving your neighbor, it reflects the idea of treating others with love and respect, which aligns with Jesus' message.
